title: ZATAZ: fake Ducros spice-box contest on TikTok leads to a fake shop that asks for card details
date_note: Publication day of the ZATAZ page; it gives no earlier day for the scam.
summary: ZATAZ reports sponsored TikTok videos, 19 of which it spotted, promising a spice assortment to everyone who answers a survey. The link leads to a site whose address shows deals-now, which ZATAZ says is not the official site. The order lists a 2,85 € delivery fee, after which the site asks for card details.
plain: ZATAZ says fake TikTok ads offer a free Ducros spice box for a survey, then send people to a non-official site that asks for card details to pay a 2,85 € delivery fee.
exec: ZATAZ reports a scam using the Ducros name on TikTok to collect personal and card data.
action: General advice: do not enter card details on a site whose address is not the brand's official one, even for a small delivery fee.
geo_basis: French-language report about a French brand; no city stated

evidence.quote: Les deux vidéos (ZATAZ en a repéré 19) promettent un assortiment à tous les participants au sondage.

validation.note: Only ZATAZ read; no Ducros statement checked.
